edition_angle: Exploring the gut-liver-muscle axis reveals how metabolic remodeling, mitochondrial dysfunction, and oxidative stress drive tissue degradation in sarcopenia and systemic decline.

assignments.angle: Investigate how protein malnutrition and nutrient excess trigger structural hepatic remodeling, impair mitochondrial function, and drive muscle degradation via the gut-liver-muscle axis.
assignments.reason: This review offers a robust physiological mechanism integrating mitochondrial decay, metabolic remodeling, and cross-organ systemic decline (sarcopenia) falling under the Inner Garden spiral, diversifying away from recent Higher Flame/Cell Shedding focus.
